newsitem.title: UK: Vitec says sells Vinten for 25.4 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Vitec says sells Vinten for 25.4 mln stg.

text.p: Vitec Group Plc said on Monday it had sold W Vinten Ltd to funds managed by BZW Private Equity Ltd for a total of 25.4 million stg.
Vitec said W Vinten is a manufacturer of specialised low and medium level reconnaissance, airborne recording and electronic counter-measure systems for defence markets.

The amount comprises cash of 20.5 million stg at completion, 1.4 million stg to be paid after a year and 3.5 million stg of zero coupon preference shares, redeemable on listing or sale of the W Vinten business, Vitec said in a statement.
Vitec said it would make an estimated exceptional profit of 16.0 million stg from the sale, which would be used to increase its cash balances.
"The transaction is expected to have a neutral effect on earnings in 1996," the group said.
Vitec's chief executive Malcolm Baggott said the disposal marked "a significant strategic development...given that it completes our withdrawal from defence-related activities".
"Future development will concentrate on commercial markets and technologies related to other companies in the group," Baggott added.
